description: Save the organization name and domain your Personal Agent Protocol file carries: pass organization_name and domain (a host name such as acme-outdoor.com). A new domain gets a new verification value and has to be checked again. Returns the file to publish at https://<domain>/.well-known/poppy.json; publish it exactly as given, then call verify_agent_protocol. Answers 404 until agent protocol files are switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domain.description: The host that will serve the file, such as acme-outdoor.com.

organization_name.description: The name personal agents show for you.

name: set_agent_protocol
